description.from:
Design-only planning requested by Ryan during voice. Implementation remains unstarted; no code, infrastructure, deployment, purchase or publishing authorization is implied. Initial status stays open (Discovery), unassigned.

As a publication editor, I want recurring intake from a few real configured sources to reach my publication classifiers, so that I can review relevant new and updated discoveries each morning.

Acceptance behavior (planned, not executable or verified yet):
```gherkin
Feature: Recurring Monitors deliver attributable morning discoveries to real classifiers
  Scenario: Repeated collection and classification
    Given 3–5 validated real sources are configured for the academic Papyrus publication, Threat Intelligence and Anth.us through common Papyrus Monitors
    And each consumer has its actual authorized Cyclotron classifier binding and current guidance
    When recurring Monitor runs execute at their configured source-appropriate cadence, around 15 minutes where permitted
    Then new and meaningfully updated source items pass through existing intake and canonical deduplication
    And resumable checkpoints and source observation/revision provenance are retained
    And actual classifier decisions retain publication scope, classifier/model identity, input revision, decision identity and relevant guidance provenance
    And the morning review can inspect the resulting discoveries and classification evidence
    And a manually researched candidate list alone does not satisfy this scenario
    And agent discovery or classification never silently creates a human training label
  Scenario: Resume and report partial failures
    Given a recurring run stops after processing some source items
    When the run resumes or retries from its recorded checkpoint
    Then unchanged items are not duplicated and changed items retain update history
    And failed or pending collection, intake and classifier stages remain distinguishable and visible
    And a classifier failure is not presented as successful classification
    And source-specific limits and backoff are respected
  Scenario: Keep the slice independent of outbound publishing
    Given Markus authored-page migration, outbound feeds, headless delivery or email monitoring are not complete
    When the recurring feed or crawler slice is evaluated
    Then those unrelated features do not block Monitoring acceptance
    And all three publications use the shared capability with their own authorized configurations
```

Latest priority and initial consumers: inbound Monitoring is Ryan's highest near-term value, independent of Markus for everything, outbound RSS/Atom and headless delivery. Initial consumers are the academic Papyrus publication, Threat Intelligence AND Anth.us, configured through the same publication-agnostic Papyrus capability rather than special implementations. Morning relevant discoveries must reach the actual configured Cyclotron classifiers with attributable classification evidence; a manual research list alone is not completion. No automatic human labels. No blocking dependency on the Markus initiative, outgoing feeds, authored-page migration or email-monitor implementation is introduced.

First small vertical slice: validate and configure 3–5 real sources across those consumers, prioritizing Hacker News, arXiv AI papers, the current Hugging Face paper offering, security/privacy publications and CVE/advisory sources. Final source/publication bindings are verified, not inferred. Cadence is configurable around 15 minutes where source limits and update frequency permit, with checkpoints, deduplication, new/updated-item handling, provenance and visible retryable failures. The desired “tonight or tomorrow” urgency expresses value, not permission to deploy or start coding.

Source validation evidence from this planning pass: https://huggingface.co/papers currently identifies Daily Papers (daily/weekly/monthly views) and offers email subscription; no official RSS feed, stable API contract or Papers With Code successor status was established. Validate an allowed feed/API/crawler method before selecting it. Official arXiv RSS/Atom documentation https://info.arxiv.org/help/rss.html describes subject feeds and daily updates; its cadence need not be 15 minutes. Review current source terms/rate/access requirements before implementation. HN candidates remain https://news.ycombinator.com/rss and https://github.com/HackerNews/API . No subscriptions, mailbox connections, model calls or paid access in this task.

Future acceptance must include observed recurring execution and real classifier receipts, not only mocks or manual research. Source/model runs require later implementation authorization. Current publication keys, deployment availability and classifier capability remain verification work.
